goal: Prevent transactions intended for private broadcast from inadvertently leaking to public peers
Safeguards node origin privacy when local triggers like wallet rebroadcasts or RPCs re-announce them
agreement: Addressed test determinism suggestion by disabling trickle delay globally (maflcko)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents node origin privacy leaks by ensuring private transactions stay off public peers
